main_text.l: stus[?][* præ participibus suis.] V. Cùm cuius cœlesti maiestate
nullum Diadema comparctur : cui [* claudere cœlos, & ape-
rire, detrudere ad inferos, & eruere] quoscunque velit
concessum est. VI. Cui à Deo rerum omnium potestas tribu-
ta est. VII. [* Sponsus Ecclesiæ] Catholicæ; Præpositus [* su-
pra Gentes & Regna, vt euellat] &c. VIII. A cuius nu-
tu pendent leges; cuius voluntas pro lege; vox pro oraculo. IX.
Sanctæ & vniuersalis Ecclesiæ Pastor, iuxta Apostolum, [*
Super omnem principatum & potestatem, & omne quod no-
minatur siue in hoc, siue in futuro seculo] à Deo constitutus.
X. Christi, & Dei Vicarius, in quo illud Propheticum rursus
impleatur, [* Adorabunt eum omnes Reges, omnes Gen-
tes seruient ei.] XI. Quo nihil maius videt Luna globus.
Hæc omnia Narratore Authorum, quos citat, omnium
prodigiosissimo adulatore Abrahamo Bzovio Polono.
Pergunt Alij. XII. Cuius non sufficit amplitudini nomen
hoc Pontifex Max. nisi adiuncto hoc titulo, Episcopus Episco-
porum. XIII. Est [* lapis positus in Sion, probatus, pretio-
sus, angularis, fundamentum summum.] XIV. Sub cuius
plane supremi in terris numinis tutela opus meum in lucem
emissum. XV. In consortium induuidue vnitatis assumptus.
XVI. DOMINVS NOSTER DEVS PAPA.
Hæc illi Oratores, Theologi, Glossatores, Episcopi, Cardina-
lesq; Pontificij (post quæ tam monstrosa Papārum[?] enco-
mia vix quicquam CHRISTO IESV relictum est inte-
grum) blasphemis suis dictis scriptisque Pontificibus tri-
buerunt; quæ Pontifices ipsi ita auidis auribus oculis-
que hauserunt, vt hæc instar Apocalypseos esse possint,
quibus spiritus Antichristianus manifeste detegatur, &
deprehendatur. Hæc vero vt Te nihil moueant? Tu enim
progrederis.

page.notes: Reference marks in the text (numbers 6 to 16 in the margin) could not be located with certainty, so the notes are placed by their position in the text, not by a mark. The first word of the page ("stus") is a fragment; its first letter is doubtful. "Papārum" has a Cyrillic-looking letter in the scan; the reading is doubtful. Several marginal references are hard to read (Egidius, Ioh. Rabo, Ferd. Valasceus, Iosua Rideinus, Stapliton, Extravag.) and their exact wording may be wrong. The position of the notes relative to the lines is approximate. Note "Cardina-lesq;" is hyphenated across the line end as printed. "induuidue" is as printed in the scan.
